title: Voyager 1: A Message to the Stars
subtitle: 考点：太空探索 / launch, spacecraft, billion
passage: Voyager 1 is a small spacecraft with no people on board. It was launched in 1977 to visit Jupiter and Saturn, and it sent back wonderful pictures of these planets. After its mission, it kept travelling, and today it is in the space between the stars, billions of kilometres from Earth.

Voyager 1 carries a golden record. On it there are sounds and pictures from Earth, such as greetings in many languages, music and the sound of rain. Scientists hoped that someone, one day, might find it. But space is huge. The nearest star after the sun, Proxima Centauri, is more than four light-years away, and Voyager 1 would need tens of thousands of years to reach that area. The record is like a bottle thrown into a very big ocean.
